basis: Visible features are annotated from the reference. Orthographic dimensions and hidden surfaces are an explicit design hypothesis, not recovered ground truth and not traced from the candidate model.
uncertainties: The visible chin optic may not lie on the true symmetry plane. Its image position must not determine the entire airframe centreline.
Left and right apparent wingtip corners may not be corresponding corners in this perspective image.
The rear, belly, internal mass distribution, landing gear and complete inlet depth are not visible.
Dimensions use the fan spacing and visible silhouette as proportion cues. One perspective view does not uniquely determine these orthographic dimensions.
